title: Spectral scalar curvature and Urysohn width in dimension three
summary: Every connected complete smooth Riemannian three-manifold without boundary satisfying $`-4\Delta+\mathop{\mathrm{Scal}}\nolimits \ge\lambda\gt 0`$ as a quadratic-form inequality admits a continuous map to a graph whose entire fibers have diameter at most $`500/\sqrt\lambda`$ in the original metric. No orientability, spin, compactness, or bounded-geometry assumption is required.
family_title: Spectral scalar curvature, Urysohn width, and macroscopic dimension

review.reason: Bounds Urysohn width of complete 3-manifolds under spectral scalar curvature bounds.
